notes: Probe: concealed carry/weapons 0.78-0.98, 'carry a firearm' 0.87 (peak ' a'), 'hat-wearing'/'sunglasses-wearing' 0.63-0.69 (peak '-w'), gun-wielding 0.33. Contrasts: 'concealed compartment' 0.04, 'carry a heavy box' 0.02. So the context predicts a weapon or wearing; the bare word ' concealed' or 'carry a' does not fire.
